text: Kidney-specific transporters at the plasma membrane that have no detectable mRNA in liver, leaving out targets of FDA-approved drugs.
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Kidney / Tissue enriched AND Protein class: Transporters AND Subcellular location (ICC): Plasma membrane AND NOT Protein class: FDA approved drug targets
understanding: The question asks for transporter genes specifically expressed in the kidney, localized to the plasma membrane, lacking detectable mRNA expression in the liver, and excluding targets of FDA-approved drugs.

trail.why: "Tissue enriched" defines genes with at least four-fold higher mRNA expression in the specified tissue (kidney) compared to any other tissue.
Selecting the class 'Transporters' captures the transporter requirement without restricting to any specific subclass.
Selecting 'Plasma membrane' directly fulfills the requirement for proteins localized at the plasma membrane without imposing restrictions on reliability or localization category.

trail.requirement: leaving out targets of FDA-approved drugs
trail.why: The requirement specifies excluding targets of FDA-approved drugs, which maps directly to the class 'FDA approved drug targets' at Level 1 without restricting Level 2.

requirements.why: This field categorizes RNA tissue specificity across human tissue types, allowing selection of genes specific to kidney.

requirements.why: This field contains the drug targets classification, specifically 'FDA approved drug targets', which can be excluded using NOT.
